title: Where to Steer: Input-Dependent Layer Selection for Steering Improves LLM Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2604.03867v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Steering vectors have emerged as a lightweight and effective approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) at inference time, enabling modulation of model behaviors by shifting intermediate representations toward a target behavior. Many existing steering methods apply interventions at globally fixed locations in an LLM, effectively treating the optimal intervention location as input-invariant. However, representations relevant to a target behavior can be encoded at different LLM layers depending on the input. translated_title: 《在何处引导：基于输入依赖的引导层选择改进大语言模型对齐》
translated_abstract: 引导向量已成为一种在推理时对齐大语言模型（LLM）的轻量且有效的方法，它通过将中间表示向目标行为偏移来调节模型行为。许多现有的引导方法在LLM的全局固定位置应用干预，实际上将最优干预位置视为与输入无关。然而，与目标行为相关的表示可能根据输入的不同而在LLM的不同层被编码。我们从理论上证明，不同的输入可能需要在不同层进行引导才能实现与给定行为的对齐；在实证上，我们也观察到最有效的引导层在不同输入之间差异显著。基于这些观察，我们提出了Where to Steer（W2S），一个通用框架，通过学习从输入到干预层的映射，根据输入自适应地选择干预层。
tldr: 该论文发现最优引导层因输入而异，并提出W2S框架，根据输入自适应地选择引导干预的最佳层位置，从而改进大语言模型的推理时对齐效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the optimal steering layer varies across inputs and proposes W2S, a general framework that adaptively selects intervention layers conditioned on each input, improving LLM inference-time alignment over fixed-layer steering methods.
